title_as_printed: Temperature, pressure and NaCl content of vapor in equilibrium with liquid and with solid NaCl.
property_description: NaCl content (printed NaCl %, basis not stated, presumably weight percent) of the vapor of the three-phase assemblage vapor + liquid + halite; the pressure column is the three-phase pressure (vapor pressure of the halite-saturated solution)
pressure_note: not stated whether gauge or absolute; three-phase univariant pressure, measured by transducer
notes: First row (300.3 C) has no printed NaCl value in the table; kept with value empty. Text says vapor composition data start at 300 C.
